content.text:
The test passes.

The change request — "Show the invoice list a page at a time with next and previous" — is implemented. Since the test seeds via the existing `/__test__/seed` (which already handles `invoices`) and reads through the existing `/api/invoices` endpoint, no schema migration or new server endpoint was needed; the pagination is a small, additive, local change to the one feature that owns the list.

What I did in `src/main/frontend/features/invoices/AllInvoicesPage.tsx`:
- Added a `page` state and a `PAGE_SIZE = 10` constant; slice the (optionally filtered) invoices into the current page.
- Clamp the page to the available range so changing the status filter can't strand you on an empty page, and reset to page 1 when the filter changes.
- Added a `invoice-pagination` nav with `invoice-page-prev`, `invoice-page-label` (shows the current page number), and `invoice-page-next` controls, disabled at the ends — matching the `data-testid` anchors the spec asserts.

With 15 seeded invoices: page 1 shows 10 rows (label "1"), Next shows the remaining 5 (label "2"), and Previous returns to 10 — exactly what the spec checks. The existing `data-testid`s (`invoice-row-*`, `invoice-status-filter`, etc.) are untouched.
